tools.name: query_revenue
tools.description: Net integer cents and revenue event counts by source, page, profile or session. Cents are exact decimal strings; null labels mean unattributed. Defaults to the last seven days.

tools.name: query_profiles
tools.description: Lists identified profiles with current typed traits after sets and increments. Filter by id or search; page_size is 1–100. Reads retained history.

tools.name: query_groups
tools.description: Lists groups with their current name and typed traits after sets and increments. Filter by type, id or search; page_size is 1–100. Reads retained history.

tools.name: connect_source
tools.description: Connects a new source in one step: creates the source and an ingestion key bound to it, and returns {source, key: {id, prefix, secret}, setup} where setup holds ready-to-paste snippets (integration: browser, typescript, http or rust; omit for all four). The secret is shown only once.

allowed_origins.description:
Origins the key accepts events from, such as https://example.com or
https://*.example.com. Empty accepts any origin.

icon.description: The source's icon, as for create_source.

integration.description: `browser`, `typescript`, `http` or `rust`. Omit it for all four snippets.

label.description: The key's label. Defaults to the source name.

tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Creates an event ingestion key for a source and returns {id, key, source_id, allowed_origins, kind}. Public pk_ keys are the default. Secret sk_ server keys permit integer-cent revenue and reject browser requests; never put them in browser code. The secret is shown once. For a new source, connect_source creates a public key.

allowed_origins.description: Origins the key accepts events from. Empty accepts any origin.

kind.description: Public by default. Server keys permit revenue, must stay secret, and require empty allowed_origins.

source.description: The source the key sends to (id or slug). Defaults to the project's initial source.

tools.name: create_log_key
tools.description: Creates a log key (a `pl_` key for /api/logs/ingest) and returns {id, key, source_id}. The key is shown only once.

source.description: The source the key writes logs for (id or slug). Defaults to the initial source.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a project with its initial `events` source. retention_days defaults to 365. Returns the project.

retention_days.description: How many days events are kept, 1–3650. Defaults to 365.

website_url.description: The project's website, such as https://example.com. Highkey fetches its icon.

tools.name: create_source
tools.description: Adds a source (a place events come from, such as a website or an app) to a project. icon is one of website, ios, android, mobile, terminal, desktop, server, code, package, game, generic. Returns the source.

icon.description:
One of website, ios, android, mobile, terminal, desktop, server, code, package, game or
generic. Omit it to pick one automatically.

name.description: The source's name, 1–80 bytes, unique in the project.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Permanently deletes a dashboard and its revisions. `confirm` must equal the dashboard's slug.

confirm.description: The dashboard's slug, repeated to confirm that it and its revisions may be deleted.

tools.name: delete_view
tools.description: Permanently deletes a saved view. `confirm` must equal the view's slug. Pass kind when an events view and a logs view share the slug.

confirm.description: The view's slug, repeated to confirm that it may be deleted.

kind.description: `events` or `logs`; needed only when both kinds have a view with this slug.

tools.name: describe_project
tools.description: Describes a project: event names and property keys, log services and levels, sources, retention and the document limits, including those of funnels and retention. Call this first.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Returns a dashboard with its document and current revision. Read it before changing it, and pass the revision as base_revision when saving.

tools.name: get_log_settings
tools.description: Reads a project's log settings: {retention_days}. Logs are kept 7 days unless changed.

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Returns a saved view with its document. Pass kind when an events view and a logs view share the slug.

kind.description: `events` or `logs`; needed only when both kinds have a view with this slug.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: Lists a project's dashboards: id, slug, name, revision and widget count.

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: Lists a project's ingestion keys: id, label, prefix, source_id, allowed_origins, revoked. Secrets are never shown again.

tools.name: list_log_keys
tools.description: Lists a project's log keys: id, source_id, label, prefix, revoked.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists the projects: id, slug, name and event retention in days. Every other tool takes a project's id or slug.

tools.name: list_revisions
tools.description: Lists the kept revisions of a dashboard, newest first, with who wrote each (dashboard, mcp or api).

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Lists a project's sources: id, slug, name and icon.

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: Lists a project's saved views (named queries for the Events and Logs pages), optionally of one kind.

tools.name: restore_revision
tools.description: Brings back an earlier revision of a dashboard as a new revision: the undo for a save. Returns {id, slug, revision, warnings, bench}.

revision.description: The revision to bring back as a new revision.

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revokes an ingestion key for good: events sent with it are rejected from now on. `confirm` must equal the key id. Returns {id, revoked}.

confirm.description: The key's id again, to confirm that it stops working for good.

key.description: The key's id, from list_keys or list_log_keys.

tools.name: revoke_log_key
tools.description: Revokes a log key for good. `confirm` must equal the key id. Returns {id, revoked}.

confirm.description: The key's id again, to confirm that it stops working for good.

key.description: The key's id, from list_keys or list_log_keys.

tools.name: run_widget
tools.description: Runs one widget definition and returns its series (or rows and columns for lists and tables), the range actually used, any warnings and elapsed_ms. Series are trimmed to their newest 200 points and tables to their first 50 rows, with a warning. Use it to preview every widget before saving.

from.description: Start of the range, RFC 3339 or a date. Defaults to seven days before `to`.

source_id.description: Limits every query of the widget to one source (a source id).

to.description: End of the range, RFC 3339 or a date. Defaults to now.

widget.description: One widget of the dashboard document, exactly as it would be saved.

tools.name: sample_events
tools.description: Shows up to 20 of the newest events of the last 7 days, to see real names and property shapes. These are raw events.

limit.description: How many rows, at most 20 (the default).

tools.name: sample_logs
tools.description: Shows up to 20 of the newest logs of the last 7 days, to see real services, levels and messages. These are raw logs.

level.description: Only logs at exactly this level: trace, debug, info, warn, error or fatal.

limit.description: How many rows, at most 20 (the default).

search.description: Only logs whose message contains this text.

tools.name: save_dashboard
tools.description: Saves a dashboard document. Without `dashboard` it creates one; with it, it replaces that dashboard (base_revision, the revision from get_dashboard, is required so you never overwrite someone else's change). The document is validated and every widget is timed first; errors carry JSON paths and hints. Returns {id, slug, revision, warnings, bench}.

base_revision.description:
Required with `dashboard`: the `revision` from get_dashboard. The save is refused with
`revision_conflict` when the dashboard has moved on.

dashboard.description: The id or slug of the dashboard to replace. Omit it to create a new dashboard.

document.description: The `highkey.dashboard/v1` document; see the highkey://schema/dashboard.v1 resource.

tools.name: save_view
tools.description: Saves a view document (a named query for the Events or Logs page; its `kind` says which, events by default). Without `view` it creates one; with it, it replaces that view in full and keeps its slug. Returns the stored view.

document.description: The view document. Its `kind` (`events` by default) says which page it belongs to.

view.description:
The id or slug of the view to replace in full. Omit it to create a new view. When both
kinds have a view with this slug, the document must state its `kind`.

tools.name: update_key_origins
tools.description: Replaces the origins an ingestion key accepts events from; an empty list accepts any origin. Returns {id, allowed_origins} as normalized.

allowed_origins.description: The complete new list of allowed origins; empty accepts any origin.

key.description: The ingestion key's id, from list_keys.

tools.name: update_log_settings
tools.description: Changes a project's log settings. Only the given fields change (today: retention_days, 1–365). Returns the settings.

retention_days.description: How many days logs are kept, 1–365. Omit it to leave the settings as they are.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Changes a project's name, website or event retention. Only the given fields change; website_url "" removes the website. Returns the project.

tools.name: update_revenue_settings
tools.description: Reads or changes a project's browser-revenue policy. Off by default: revenue requires a secret server event key. Only owners and admins may change this setting.

allow_browser_revenue.description: Whether public keys may send integer-cent revenue. Omit to read the current setting.

tools.name: update_source
tools.description: Renames a source or changes its icon; only the given fields change and the slug stays. Returns the source.

icon.description: A new icon. Omit it to keep the current one.

name.description: A new name. The slug stays the same.

tools.name: validate_dashboard
tools.description: Checks a dashboard document without saving it. Returns {valid, errors, warnings}; each issue has a JSON path, a message and often a hint. Unknown event names and properties only warn.

document.description: The `highkey.dashboard/v1` document; see the highkey://schema/dashboard.v1 resource.

resources.name: Dashboard JSON Schema
resources.description: The JSON Schema of a highkey.dashboard/v1 document

resources.name: Dashboards guide
resources.description: How to write dashboards: queries, series, formulas, views, limits and examples

prompts.name: build_dashboard
prompts.description: Build and save a dashboard for a goal, checking each step

prompts.name: daily_report
prompts.description: Set up a daily report that is saved in the repository, run once and scheduled
